metadata.name: Stoat
metadata.description: Stoat is a self-hosted chat server, formerly Revolt. This stack runs the API, web app, file server, proxy, and voice ingress behind Caddy.
metadata.author: BigBearTechWorld

environment_variables.name: HOSTNAME
environment_variables.description: Caddy site address. Default is https://stoat.localhost. Change this literal, the VITE variables, and every REVOLT__HOSTS__* value to the public origin before the first start. Caddy reads this value when the container starts.

environment_variables.name: MINIO_ROOT_USER
environment_variables.description: Silo root user. Must match the S3 access key.

environment_variables.name: MINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: Silo root password. Must match the S3 secret. The catalog value is public. Replace it in the install form before the first start, and use the same LiveKit key and secret in livekit.yml. CasaOS and ZimaOS do not substitute Compose variables.

environment_variables.name: MINIO_DOMAIN
environment_variables.description: Silo domain used for bucket aliases.

environment_variables.name: REVOLT__DATABASE__MONGODB
environment_variables.description: MongoDB URL for the database service.

environment_variables.name: REVOLT__DATABASE__REDIS
environment_variables.description: Valkey URL for the redis service.

environment_variables.name: REVOLT__RABBIT__PASSWORD
environment_variables.description: RabbitMQ password. The catalog value is public. Replace it in the install form before the first start, and use the same LiveKit key and secret in livekit.yml. CasaOS and ZimaOS do not substitute Compose variables.

environment_variables.name: REVOLT__FILES__ENCRYPTION_KEY
environment_variables.description: File encryption key. Losing it loses access to stored files. The catalog value is public. Replace it in the install form before the first start, and use the same LiveKit key and secret in livekit.yml. CasaOS and ZimaOS do not substitute Compose variables.

environment_variables.name: REVOLT__FILES__S3__ENDPOINT
environment_variables.description: S3 endpoint for the silo service.

environment_variables.name: REVOLT__PUSHD__VAPID__PRIVATE_KEY
environment_variables.description: Web push VAPID private key. The catalog value is public. Replace it in the install form before the first start, and use the same LiveKit key and secret in livekit.yml. CasaOS and ZimaOS do not substitute Compose variables.

environment_variables.name: REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__KEY
environment_variables.description: LiveKit API key. Must match livekit.yml. The catalog value is public. Replace it in the install form before the first start, and use the same LiveKit key and secret in livekit.yml. CasaOS and ZimaOS do not substitute Compose variables.

environment_variables.name: REVOLT__API__LIVEKIT__NODES__WORLDWIDE__SECRET
environment_variables.description: LiveKit API secret. Must match livekit.yml. The catalog value is public. Replace it in the install form before the first start, and use the same LiveKit key and secret in livekit.yml. CasaOS and ZimaOS do not substitute Compose variables.

ports.description: Caddy HTTP. Official host port 80 is already published, so this listing uses 20001.
Caddy HTTPS. Official host port 443 is already published, so this listing uses 20002.
LiveKit RTC UDP. Official ports 50000-50100 overlap habridge on 50000, so LiveKit and the published range both use 21028-21128.

before_install.en_us: The hostname is the literal stoat.localhost. CasaOS and ZimaOS do not substitute Compose variables. Before the first start, replace stoat.localhost in HOSTNAME, the VITE variables, every REVOLT__HOSTS__* value, Revolt.toml, and the Caddy network alias. Point DNS at this machine. Forward external port 80 to host 20001 and external port 443 to host 20002. The shipped RabbitMQ password, Silo password, file encryption key, VAPID key, and LiveKit key pair are public. Replace them before storing data or exposing voice, then keep the file encryption key stable. The LiveKit key and secret in the API environment must match livekit.yml. Forward UDP 21028-21128 and TCP 7881 for voice. The web image publishes amd64 only.
